newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania tries to slow buses, save lives.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania tries to slow buses, save lives.

text.p: Tanzanian bus operators scrambled to comply with a government deadline of Saturday for fitting speed control limiters to their buses.
Local media reports said several thousand owner-operators are affected by the order, widely opposed by the industry. Buses that fail to comply will be forced off the road.
More than 1,000 people die each year on Tanzania's roads and the government hopes the devices will make bus travel safer. A similar plan in neighbouring Kenya last year failed.
